strings.Bu bilgisayarın mikrofonunu dinler. \"Me: Listens to this computer's microphone. When you say "Mehbur" or "Hey Mehbur" it replies "At your service" and waits for your command (ask a question, "open notepad", "shut down the computer" ...). It also tries to understand misheard words. Recognition is fully offline; the reply voice is generated online. The first launch downloads a ~35 MB Turkish voice model.

strings.MehburAI açıkken sen bir süre soru sorma: While MehburAI is open, if you don't ask anything for a while it learns new topics from Wikipedia in the background and saves them to memory (it uses them offline too). For products it pulls specs and critic/press reviews from Wikipedia (no unmoderated sources like Reddit).
